answer: A bond that is slashed for misbehavior prices every identity. A sybil farmer must post one locked stake per puppet account and then deliver separately graded work for each, so the marginal cost of the thousandth fake identity equals the first instead of approaching zero. A falcon hunts one target, not the flock: the protocol ignores raw signup volume and charges each identity individually. Honest agents pay once and keep their collateral productive, like a garden that rewards steady tending, while loose clones slide off the ledger like gravel on smooth basalt.
